To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Vrancea seismic source specific energy release pattern is defined, and a new window function is proposed for modeling this pattern in stochastic simulations.

(a) the energy release in the ground motions generated by the Vrancea intermediate seismic source has a specific pattern, (b) the pattern is described by a two interval window that has a rapid release of energy (first 50 70%) and a slow release of energy (rest of it), (c) the parameters of the window function can be defined based on the mean normalized cumulative energy of a set of recorded ground motions,
the Vrancea seismic source has a specific energy release that is different from other seismic sources and the energy release can be described by a two interval window function.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the determination of a new energy release function for the Vrancea source and with its implementation into a simulation algorithm, with the aim to obtain more realistic results in terms of energy distribution in time.
the development of a new window function that can be implemented in SMSIM and EXSIM for simulating ground motion generated by Vrancean intermediate depth seismic source.

the development of an appropriate window function for describing the specific energy release for ground motions generated by intermediate depth seismic source, which can be used for generating ground motions in stochastic simulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Vrancea intermediate deep source has a very specific release of energy in time domain, which can be described by the two interval window function.

, for the Vrancea intermediate seismic source, the two interval window function, with a very fast initial release, a slower one and a very slow release of the rest of the energy (the last one being responsible for the duration parameters), is more appropriate for describing the energy release than the exponential function.
the energy release of ground motion produced by Vrancea source is not exponential, but it can be described by a more complex two interval function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Vrancea source specific energy release is described by an exponential window with two intervals.

the Vrancea intermediate source generates a specific release of energy that is not properly represented by a single exponential window function, but by a two interval function, and the parameters for this function are presented in the current paper.
the stochastic simulation of ground motion generated by Vrancean source can be improved by implementing a more adequate window that describes the specific energy release pattern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the stochastic simulations of ground motions generated from Vrancea source should consider the Vrancea source specificity in energy release.
the energy release of Vrancea intermediate deep earthquakes is not a simple exponential process.

the duration parameters of ground motions generated at the surface by Vrancea earthquakes are not consistent with the source and path durations, but they can be described by a two interval window that has a fast release of energy for the first 70% and a very slow release for the rest of the energy.
